## Summary

Extended NIH SBIR accessibility prototype with IC recommendation feature. Key finding: NIAID, NCI, NHLB, NIA are consensus accessible ICs across 4/5 spending categories (101, 108, 525, 701, 176). Prototype at tools/nih_accessibility_prototype.py now includes IC recommendations building on the 5-category pattern. No product commitment.

## Next
